//: SA §TS-12.3 / SD §FE-10 — every fully-qualified catalogue key carries a tier, and the TIER DRIVES THE GATE. Fully-qualified key = '<namespace>.<key>', where <namespace> is the catalogue filename and <key> is the flat dotted key inside it. Assignment is EXACT and EXHAUSTIVE: there is no prefix rule, no namespace default and no inherited tier, because a key that silently inherits `marketing` from its neighbours is exactly how a safety string escapes gate:locale-completeness. A key present in catalogues/en/ with no entry here is a COMPILE FAILURE (fail-closed).
